prompts.prompt:
Include which optional capability groups? Reply with comma-separated keys,
or 'accept' (recommended), 'all', or 'none'.
  [business] Business & Market Analysis - recommended: INCLUDE (Discovery/ideation mention: business, market, persona, target user)
      get: Product definition (vision, scope, personas, Jobs-to-be-Done) plus market, competitor and positioning analysis
      if skipped: No market validation or positioning; later design/architecture stages lose business context
  [monetization] Monetization & Pricing - recommended: skip (no requirement signal found in discovery/ideation)
      get: Revenue model, pricing/packaging and unit economics (cost per user, margins, break-even)
      if skipped: No pricing or unit-economics output (fine for non-commercial products)
  [gtm] Go-to-Market & Customer Journey - recommended: skip (no requirement signal found in discovery/ideation)
      get: Launch plan, channels, customer journey and marketing strategy
      if skipped: No go-to-market / launch plan
  [operations] Operations & Observability - recommended: skip (no requirement signal found in discovery/ideation)
      get: Production operations: monitoring, SLAs, incidents, uptime and runbooks
      if skipped: No operations/monitoring setup
  [support] Customer Success & Support - recommended: INCLUDE (Discovery/ideation mention: onboarding, retention)
      get: Onboarding flows, support processes and customer-success playbooks
      if skipped: No customer support model
  [growth] Growth, Engagement & Feedback - recommended: INCLUDE (Discovery/ideation mention: retention, churn, loop)
      get: Retention/growth loops, engagement and feedback capture
      if skipped: No growth/retention strategy
  [legal] Legal, Privacy & Compliance - recommended: INCLUDE (Discovery/ideation mention: compliance)
      get: Data handling/privacy, compliance review, plus security and accessibility audit
      if skipped: Compliance/legal risk; strongly recommended if the product handles personal data
